audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page tells the reader to track Relentless Pursuit and never says what it costs, and wants.foe[1] has Lucian 'dash in for a burst trade and dash back out'.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — one of the longest dashes on a marksman, and he does NOT get it back inside a trade. But Riot's text adds the real rule: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown', so it comes back on his auto count, not on a clock. That is the sequencing cue the page was missing: count his double-shots, not seconds.
audit.corrected: 16s and the auto-reduction written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5], mid and wants.foe[1]; Piercing Light's 9s and The Culling's 110s added.

audit.why: Riot's text: when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, Lucian's next 2 basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. In a top lane that means any jungle CC landed on you arms his burst before he has even stepped up — so a gank on you is worth more to him than the CC itself, and the nest fight you would normally take becomes the wrong fight.

missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal and shield-absorbs-burst on Lightslinger. Both are flag misfires: Riot's text says Lucian gains bonus damage when he IS healed or shielded BY AN ALLY — he gains no heal and no shield of his own. No anti-heal was added and no shield was written to the page.

Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: 'Use Lightslinger' is the correct name with a verb in front, and 'Hextech Affinity's' is Heimerdinger's own passive in the possessive. No name edits made on that basis.

notes: Two chart rows contradicted the paragraphs printed under them (level 1 and 2+ items) and both now match packet.levelChart. The sequencing rule this page needed is that Relentless Pursuit is a long 16s at rank 1 but is reduced by every Lightslinger double-shot — so you count his autos, not a stopwatch, and wants.foe[1]'s 'dash in and dash back out' was not possible on a single 16s charge. New interaction added: Lightslinger gives him bonus damage on his next 2 attacks whenever a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, so his jungler's CC on you arms his burst before he steps up. Both packet suspectNames are false positives.
